summary: Draw the detection bounding box + object-label tag onto AI alert notification snapshots server-side (vision.AnnotateJPEG) so webhook/Telegram images match the AI Log detail overlay; add opt-in GET /api/vision/alerts/{id}/snapshot?annotated=1 and a Log detail 'Download with box' button. Default snapshot stays raw for the frontend overlay
compatibility: Adds golang.org/x/image as a direct dependency for image annotation. Box drawing is skipped when the alert has no bounding box or the bounding-box field is disabled.
